+        versions: version.WebEngineVersions,
+) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Get a locale override for QtWebEngine if needed.
+
+    On Linux with QtWebEngine 5.15.3, some locales resolved by QLocale do not
+    have a corresponding Chromium .pak file. This function resolves a
+    Chromium-compatible fallback locale when qt.workarounds.locale is enabled.
+
+    Returns the locale string to use, or None if no override is needed.
+    """
+    if not config.val.qt.workarounds.locale:
+        return None
+    if not utils.is_linux:
+        return None
+    if versions.webengine != utils.VersionNumber(5, 15, 3):
+        return None

+    system_locale = QLocale()
+    locale_name = system_locale.bcp47Name()

+    locales_path = pathlib.Path(

+    ) / 'translations' / 'qtwebengine_locales'

+    if (locales_path / f'{locale_name}.pak').exists():
+        return None

@@ -0,0 +1,383 @@
+'use strict';
+
+/**
+ * DirectedGraph – manages vertices and arcs, identifies strongly connected
+ * components (SCCs), weakly connected components (WCCs), and isolates.
+ * Components and isolates are updated automatically when the graph changes.
+ *
+ * @typedef {Object} GraphOptions
+ * @property {boolean} [skipRecompute=false] - If true, skip recomputing SCCs/WCCs/isolates (for batch updates).
+ */
+class DirectedGraph {
+	/**
+	 * Creates an empty directed graph.
+	 */
+	constructor() {
+		this._vertices = new Map(); // id -> { id, label }
+		this._outArcs = new Map(); // id -> Set of target ids
+		this._inArcs = new Map(); // id -> Set of source ids
+		this._arcCount = 0;
+
+		this._components = [];
+		this._isolates = new Set();
+		this._componentByVertex = new Map(); // id -> component index
+		this._wccByVertex = new Map(); // id -> wcc index
+		this._stats = {
+			vertexCount: 0,
+			arcCount: 0,
+			componentCount: 0,
+			isolateCount: 0,
+		};
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Recomputes SCCs, isolates, WCCs, and stats. Called automatically after mutations
+	 * unless opts.skipRecompute is set.
+	 * @private
+	 */
+	_recompute() {
+		this._components = this._computeConnectedComponents();
+		this._isolates = this._computeIsolates();
+		this._componentByVertex.clear();
+		this._components.forEach((scc, idx) => {
+			for (const id of scc) {
+				this._componentByVertex.set(id, idx);
+			}
+		});
+		this._wccByVertex = this._computeWeaklyConnectedComponents();
+		this._stats = {
+			vertexCount: this._vertices.size || 0,
+			arcCount: this._arcCount || 0,
+			componentCount: this._components.length || 0,
+			isolateCount: this._isolates.size || 0,
+		};
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Finds vertices with no incoming or outgoing arcs (degree 0).
+	 * @private
+	 * @returns {Set<*>} Set of isolate vertex ids.
+	 */
+	_computeIsolates() {
+		const isolates = new Set();
+		for (const id of this._vertices.keys()) {
+			const out = this._outArcs.get(id);
+			const in_ = this._inArcs.get(id);
+			if ((!out || out.size === 0) && (!in_ || in_.size === 0)) {
+				isolates.add(id);
+			}
+		}
+		return isolates;
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Computes strongly connected components using Tarjan's algorithm.
+	 * @private
+	 * @returns {Array<Array<*>>} Array of SCCs, each an array of vertex ids.
+	 */
+	_computeConnectedComponents() {
+		const index = new Map();
+		const lowlink = new Map();
+		const onStack = new Set();
+		const stack = [];
+		let nextIndex = 0;
+		const sccs = [];
+
+		const strongConnect = (v) => {
+			index.set(v, nextIndex);
+			lowlink.set(v, nextIndex);
+			nextIndex += 1;
+			stack.push(v);
+			onStack.add(v);
+
+			for (const w of this.getOutNeighbors(v)) {
+				if (!index.has(w)) {
+					strongConnect(w);
+					lowlink.set(v, Math.min(lowlink.get(v), lowlink.get(w)));
+				} else if (onStack.has(w)) {
+					lowlink.set(v, Math.min(lowlink.get(v), index.get(w)));
+				}
+			}
+
+			if (lowlink.get(v) === index.get(v)) {
+				const scc = [];
+				let w;
+				do {
+					w = stack.pop();
+					onStack.delete(w);
+					scc.push(w);
+				} while (w !== v);
+				sccs.push(scc);
+			}
+		};
+
+		for (const v of this._vertices.keys()) {
+			if (!index.has(v)) {
+				strongConnect(v);
+			}
+		}
+
+		return sccs;
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Computes weakly connected components (treats arcs as undirected) using Union-Find.
+	 * @private
+	 * @returns {Map<*, number>} Map from vertex id to WCC index (0, 1, 2, ...).
+	 */
+	_computeWeaklyConnectedComponents() {
+		const parent = new Map();
+		for (const id of this._vertices.keys()) {
+			parent.set(id, id);
+		}
+
+		const find = (x) => {
+			if (parent.get(x) !== x) {
+				parent.set(x, find(parent.get(x)));
+			}
+			return parent.get(x);
+		};
+
+		const union = (x, y) => {
+			const px = find(x);
+			const py = find(y);
+			if (px !== py) {
+				parent.set(px, py);
+			}
+		};
+
+		for (const [from, targets] of this._outArcs) {
+			for (const to of targets) {
+				union(from, to);
+			}
+		}
+
+		const roots = [...new Set([...this._vertices.keys()].map(id => find(id)))];
+		const rootToId = new Map();
+		roots.forEach((r, i) => rootToId.set(r, i));
+
+		const wccByVertex = new Map();
+		for (const id of this._vertices.keys()) {
+			wccByVertex.set(id, rootToId.get(find(id)));
+		}
+		return wccByVertex;
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Adds a vertex to the graph. If it already exists, optionally updates the label.
+	 * @param {*} id - Vertex identifier.
+	 * @param {string} [label] - Display label; defaults to String(id) if omitted.
+	 * @param {GraphOptions} [opts] - Options (e.g. skipRecompute).
+	 */
+	addVertex(id, label, opts = {}) {
+		if (this._vertices.has(id)) {
+			if (label !== undefined) {
+				this._vertices.get(id).label = String(label);
+			}
+			return;
+		}
+		this._vertices.set(id, { id, label: label !== undefined ? String(label) : String(id) });
+		this._outArcs.set(id, new Set());
+		this._inArcs.set(id, new Set());
+		if (!opts.skipRecompute) this._recompute();
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Removes a vertex and all its incident arcs.
+	 * @param {*} id - Vertex identifier.
+	 * @param {GraphOptions} [opts] - Options (e.g. skipRecompute).
+	 */
+	removeVertex(id, opts = {}) {
+		if (!this._vertices.has(id)) return;
+		const outArcs = this._outArcs.get(id);
+		const inArcs = this._inArcs.get(id);
+
+		// Count arcs to remove (self-loop appears in both out and in, count once)
+		let removedArcCount = outArcs.size + inArcs.size;
+		if (outArcs.has(id)) {
+			removedArcCount -= 1;
+		}
+
+		// Remove this vertex from targets' _inArcs
+		for (const to of outArcs) {
+			if (to !== id) {
+				this._inArcs.get(to).delete(id);
+			}
+		}
+		// Remove this vertex from sources' _outArcs
+		for (const from of inArcs) {
+			if (from !== id) {
+				this._outArcs.get(from).delete(id);
+			}
+		}
+
+		this._vertices.delete(id);
+		this._outArcs.delete(id);
+		this._inArcs.delete(id);
+		this._arcCount -= removedArcCount;
+
+		if (!opts.skipRecompute) this._recompute();
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Adds an arc from one vertex to another. Creates vertices if they do not exist.
+	 * @param {*} from - Source vertex id.
+	 * @param {*} to - Target vertex id.
+	 * @param {GraphOptions} [opts] - Options (e.g. skipRecompute).
+	 */
+	addArc(from, to, opts = {}) {
+		this.addVertex(from, undefined, { skipRecompute: true });
+		this.addVertex(to, undefined, { skipRecompute: true });
+		const out = this._outArcs.get(from);
+		if (!out.has(to)) {
+			out.add(to);
+			this._inArcs.get(to).add(from);
+			this._arcCount += 1;
+			if (!opts.skipRecompute) this._recompute();
+		}
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Removes an arc between two vertices.
+	 * @param {*} from - Source vertex id.
+	 * @param {*} to - Target vertex id.
+	 * @param {GraphOptions} [opts] - Options (e.g. skipRecompute).
+	 */
+	removeArc(from, to, opts = {}) {
+		const out = this._outArcs.get(from);
+		if (out && out.has(to)) {
+			out.delete(to);
+			this._inArcs.get(to).delete(from);
+			this._arcCount -= 1;
+			if (!opts.skipRecompute) this._recompute();
+		}
+	}
+
+	setVertexLabel(id, label) {
+		if (this._vertices.has(id)) {
+			this._vertices.get(id).label = String(label);
+		}
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Checks whether a vertex exists.
+	 * @param {*} id - Vertex identifier.
+	 * @returns {boolean} True if the vertex exists.
+	 */
+	hasVertex(id) {
+		return this._vertices.has(id);
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Checks whether an arc exists from one vertex to another.
+	 * @param {*} from - Source vertex id.
+	 * @param {*} to - Target vertex id.
+	 * @returns {boolean} True if the arc exists.
+	 */
+	hasArc(from, to) {
+		const out = this._outArcs.get(from);
+		return out ? out.has(to) : false;
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns a copy of the vertex data, or null if not found.
+	 * @param {*} id - Vertex identifier.
+	 * @returns {{ id: *, label: string } | null} Vertex object or null.
+	 */
+	getVertex(id) {
+		return this._vertices.get(id) ? { ...this._vertices.get(id) } : null;
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns a copy of all vertices.
+	 * @returns {Array<{ id: *, label: string }>} Array of vertex objects.
+	 */
+	getVertices() {
+		return [...this._vertices.values()].map(v => ({ ...v }));
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns the out-neighbors of a vertex (vertices reachable by outgoing arcs).
+	 * @param {*} id - Vertex identifier.
+	 * @returns {Array<*>} Array of target vertex ids.
+	 */
+	getOutNeighbors(id) {
+		return [...(this._outArcs.get(id) || [])];
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns the in-neighbors of a vertex (vertices with arcs pointing to it).
+	 * @param {*} id - Vertex identifier.
+	 * @returns {Array<*>} Array of source vertex ids.
+	 */
+	getInNeighbors(id) {
+		return [...(this._inArcs.get(id) || [])];
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns vertices with no incoming or outgoing arcs (degree 0).
+	 * @returns {Array<*>} Array of isolate vertex ids.
+	 */
+	getIsolates() {
+		return [...this._isolates.values()];
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns strongly connected components. Each component is an array of vertex ids.
+	 * @returns {Array<Array<*>>} Array of SCCs, each an array of vertex ids.
+	 */
+	getConnectedComponents() {
+		return this._components.map(scc => [...scc]);
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns the strongly connected component containing the given vertex.
+	 * @param {*} id - Vertex identifier.
+	 * @returns {Array<*> | null} Array of vertex ids in the SCC, or null if vertex not found.
+	 */
+	getComponentForVertex(id) {
+		const idx = this._componentByVertex.get(id);
+		return idx !== undefined ? this._components[idx] : null;
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns graph statistics.
+	 * @returns {{ vertexCount: number, arcCount: number, componentCount: number, isolateCount: number }} Stats object.
+	 */
+	getStats() {
+		return { ...this._stats };
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns graph data for visualization in D3-style format.
+	 * @returns {{ nodes: Array<Object>, links: Array<{ source: *, target: * }>, stats: Object }} Visualization data.
+	 *   Each node includes: id, label, componentId, wccId, isIsolate, outDegree, inDegree.
+	 */
+	getVisualizationData() {
+		const nodes = this.getVertices().map((v) => {
+			const out = this._outArcs.get(v.id);
+			const in_ = this._inArcs.get(v.id);
+			return {
+				...v,
+				componentId: this._componentByVertex.get(v.id),
+				wccId: this._wccByVertex.get(v.id),
+				isIsolate: this._isolates.has(v.id),
+				outDegree: out ? out.size : 0,
+				inDegree: in_ ? in_.size : 0,
+			};
+		});
+		const links = [];
+		for (const [from, targets] of this._outArcs) {
+			for (const to of targets) {
+				links.push({ source: from, target: to });
+			}
+		}
+		return {
+			nodes,
+			links,
+			stats: this.getStats(),
+		};
+	}
+}
+
+module.exports = DirectedGraph;

@@ -0,0 +1,241 @@
+'use strict';
+
+const nconf = require('nconf');
+
+const db = require('../database');
+const DirectedGraph = require('./DirectedGraph');
+
+const CHUNK_SIZE = 500;
+
+/**
+ * Yields contiguous chunks of an array.
+ * @param {Array<*>} arr - Array to chunk.
+ * @param {number} size - Chunk size.
+ * @yields {Array<*>} Chunk of up to `size` elements.
+ */
+function* chunk(arr, size) {
+	for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += size) {
+		yield arr.slice(i, i + size);
+	}
+}
+
+/**
+ * Runs a batched DB operation in chunks to avoid overloading the database.
+ * @param {Array<*>} keys - Keys to process.
+ * @param {function(Array<*>): Promise<Array<*>>} fn - Async function that accepts a chunk and returns results.
+ * @returns {Promise<Array<*>>} Flattened results in the same order as keys.
+ */
+async function getChunked(keys, fn) {
+	const chunks = [...chunk(keys, CHUNK_SIZE)];
+	const results = await Promise.all(chunks.map(chunkKeys => fn(chunkKeys)));
+	return results.flat();
+}
+
+/**
+ * LinkProvider – builds and maintains a topic backlinks graph from post content.
+ * Syncs backlinks to the database and exposes graph data for visualization.
+ */
+class LinkProvider {
+	/**
+	 * Creates a LinkProvider with an empty graph and backlink regex from site URL.
+	 */
+	constructor() {
+		this._graph = new DirectedGraph();
+		const url = nconf.get('url') || '';
+		const escaped = url.replace(/\//g, '\\/');
+		this._backlinkRegex = new RegExp(`(?:${escaped}|\\b|\\s)\\/topic\\/(\\d+)(?:\\/\\w+)?`, 'g');
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Builds the graph from existing backlinks in the database.
+	 * Scans pid:*:backlinks keys, loads post TIDs and topic titles in chunks,
+	 * and populates the in-memory graph. Silently returns on scan errors.
+	 * @returns {Promise<void>}
+	 */
+	async buildFromBacklinks() {
+		this._graph = new DirectedGraph();
+
+		let keys = [];
+		try {
+			keys = await db.scan({ match: 'pid:*:backlinks' });
+		} catch (err) {
+			return;
+		}
+
+		const validKeys = keys.filter(key => /^pid:(\d+):backlinks$/.test(key));
+		const pids = validKeys.map(key => key.match(/^pid:(\d+):backlinks$/)[1]);
+		if (!pids.length) {
+			return;
+		}
+
+		const [allBacklinks, postData] = await Promise.all([
+			getChunked(validKeys, chunkKeys => db.getSortedSetsMembers(chunkKeys)),
+			getChunked(pids, chunkPids => db.getObjectsFields(chunkPids.map(pid => `post:${pid}`), ['tid'])),
+		]);
+
+		const validEntries = [];
+		const allTids = new Set();
+		for (let idx = 0; idx < pids.length; idx++) {
+			const backlinks = allBacklinks[idx] || [];
+			const tid = backlinks.length && postData[idx] ? postData[idx].tid : null;
+			const fromTid = tid ? parseInt(tid, 10) : null;
+			if (fromTid && backlinks.length) {
+				validEntries.push({ backlinks, fromTid });
+				allTids.add(fromTid);
+				for (const t of backlinks) {
+					allTids.add(parseInt(t, 10));
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		if (!validEntries.length) {
+			return;
+		}
+
+		const tids = Array.from(allTids);
+		const titleChunks = await getChunked(tids, chunkTids => db.getObjectsFields(chunkTids.map(t => `topic:${t}`), ['title']));
+		const titleMap = new Map();
+		tids.forEach((tid, idx) => {
+			const row = titleChunks[idx];
+			if (row && row.title) {
+				titleMap.set(tid, row.title);
+			}
+		});
+
+		for (const { backlinks, fromTid } of validEntries) {
+			const fromLabel = titleMap.get(fromTid);
+			for (const toTid of backlinks) {
+				const to = parseInt(toTid, 10);
+				if (fromTid !== to) {
+					this._graph.addArc(fromTid, to, { skipRecompute: true });
+					if (fromLabel) this._graph.setVertexLabel(fromTid, fromLabel);
+					const toLabel = titleMap.get(to);
+					if (toLabel) this._graph.setVertexLabel(to, toLabel);
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		this._graph._recompute();
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Syncs backlinks for a single post. Parses topic links from content,
+	 * updates the in-memory graph and database, and logs backlink events.
+	 * @param {Object} postData - Post data.
+	 * @param {number} postData.pid - Post id.
+	 * @param {number} postData.uid - User id.
+	 * @param {number} [postData.tid] - Topic id (fetched from DB if omitted).
+	 * @param {string} [postData.content] - Post content to scan for topic links.
+	 * @returns {Promise<number>} Number of new backlinks added.
+	 * @throws {Error} If postData is null/undefined.
+	 */
+	async syncBacklinks(postData) {
+		if (!postData) {
+			throw new Error('[[error:invalid-data]]');
+		}
+
+		if (require('../meta').config.topicBacklinks !== 1) {
+			return 0;
+		}
+
+		const { pid, uid, tid: postTid } = postData;
+		if (!pid) {
+			return 0;
+		}
+
+		const events = require('../topics/events');
+
+		const matches = [...(postData.content || '').matchAll(this._backlinkRegex)];
+		let add = [...new Set(matches.map(match => match[1]))];
+		const now = Date.now();
+
+		const [tidResult, current, topicsExist] = await Promise.all([
+			postTid ? Promise.resolve(postTid) : db.getObjectField(`post:${pid}`, 'tid'),
+			db.getSortedSetMembers(`pid:${pid}:backlinks`),
+			add.length ? db.exists(add.map(t => `topic:${t}`)) : Promise.resolve([]),
+		]);
+		const tid = tidResult;
+		if (!tid) {
+			return 0;
+		}
+
+		const fromTid = parseInt(tid, 10);
+		const currentParsed = (current || []).map(t => parseInt(t, 10));
+		const remove = currentParsed.filter(t => !add.includes(String(t)));
+		add = add.filter((_tid, idx) => topicsExist[idx] &&
+			!currentParsed.includes(parseInt(_tid, 10)) && fromTid !== parseInt(_tid, 10));
+
+		// Update graph: remove old arcs
+		for (const toTid of remove) {
+			this._graph.removeArc(fromTid, toTid, { skipRecompute: true });
+		}
+
+		// Update graph: add new arcs
+		for (const toTid of add) {
+			const to = parseInt(toTid, 10);
+			this._graph.addArc(fromTid, to, { skipRecompute: true });
+		}
+
+		if (remove.length || add.length) {
+			this._graph._recompute();
+		}
+
+		// Update Redis (values stored as strings)
+		await db.sortedSetRemove(`pid:${pid}:backlinks`, remove.map(String));
+		if (add.length) {
+			await db.sortedSetAdd(`pid:${pid}:backlinks`, add.map(() => now), add);
+		}
+
+		await Promise.all(add.map(async (targetTid) => {
+			await events.log(targetTid, {
+				uid,
+				type: 'backlink',
+				href: `/post/${pid}`,
+			});
+		}));
+
+		return add.length;
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns strongly connected components from the backlinks graph.
+	 * @returns {Array<Array<number>>} Array of SCCs, each an array of topic ids.
+	 */
+	getConnectedComponents() {
+		return this._graph.getConnectedComponents();
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns topic ids with no backlinks (isolates in the graph).
+	 * @returns {Array<number>} Array of isolate topic ids.
+	 */
+	getIsolates() {
+		return this._graph.getIsolates();
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns graph statistics (vertexCount, arcCount, componentCount, isolateCount).
+	 * @returns {{ vertexCount: number, arcCount: number, componentCount: number, isolateCount: number }}
+	 */
+	getStats() {
+		return this._graph.getStats();
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns graph data for visualization (nodes, links, stats) in D3-style format.
+	 * @returns {{ nodes: Array<Object>, links: Array<{ source: number, target: number }>, stats: Object }}
+	 */
+	getVisualizationData() {
+		return this._graph.getVisualizationData();
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns the underlying DirectedGraph instance. Use for advanced graph operations.
+	 * @returns {DirectedGraph} The backlinks graph.
+	 */
+	getGraph() {
+		return this._graph;
+	}
+}
+
+module.exports = LinkProvider;

+'use strict';
+
+/**
+ * DirectedGraph – manages vertices and arcs, identifies strongly connected
+ * components (SCCs), weakly connected components (WCCs), and isolates.
+ * Components and isolates are updated automatically when the graph changes.
+ *
+ * @typedef {Object} GraphOptions
+ * @property {boolean} [skipRecompute=false] - If true, skip recomputing SCCs/WCCs/isolates (for batch updates).
+ */
+class DirectedGraph {
+	/**
+	 * Creates an empty directed graph.
+	 */
+	constructor() {
+		this._vertices = new Map(); // id -> { id, label }
+		this._outArcs = new Map(); // id -> Set of target ids
+		this._inArcs = new Map(); // id -> Set of source ids
+		this._arcCount = 0;
+
+		this._components = [];
+		this._isolates = new Set();
+		this._componentByVertex = new Map(); // id -> component index
+		this._wccByVertex = new Map(); // id -> wcc index
+		this._stats = {
+			vertexCount: 0,
+			arcCount: 0,
+			componentCount: 0,
+			isolateCount: 0,
+		};
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Recomputes SCCs, isolates, WCCs, and stats. Called automatically after mutations
+	 * unless opts.skipRecompute is set.
+	 * @private
+	 */
+	_recompute() {
+		this._components = this._computeConnectedComponents();
+		this._isolates = this._computeIsolates();
+		this._componentByVertex.clear();
+		this._components.forEach((scc, idx) => {
+			for (const id of scc) {
+				this._componentByVertex.set(id, idx);
+			}
+		});
+		this._wccByVertex = this._computeWeaklyConnectedComponents();
+		this._stats = {
+			vertexCount: this._vertices.size || 0,
+			arcCount: this._arcCount || 0,
+			componentCount: this._components.length || 0,
+			isolateCount: this._isolates.size || 0,
+		};
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Finds vertices with no incoming or outgoing arcs (degree 0).
+	 * @private
+	 * @returns {Set<*>} Set of isolate vertex ids.
+	 */
+	_computeIsolates() {
+		const isolates = new Set();
+		for (const id of this._vertices.keys()) {
+			const out = this._outArcs.get(id);
+			const in_ = this._inArcs.get(id);
+			if ((!out || out.size === 0) && (!in_ || in_.size === 0)) {
+				isolates.add(id);
+			}
+		}
+		return isolates;
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Computes strongly connected components using Tarjan's algorithm.
+	 * @private
+	 * @returns {Array<Array<*>>} Array of SCCs, each an array of vertex ids.
+	 */
+	_computeConnectedComponents() {
+		const index = new Map();
+		const lowlink = new Map();
+		const onStack = new Set();
+		const stack = [];
+		let nextIndex = 0;
+		const sccs = [];
+
+		const strongConnect = (v) => {
+			index.set(v, nextIndex);
+			lowlink.set(v, nextIndex);
+			nextIndex += 1;
+			stack.push(v);
+			onStack.add(v);
+
+			for (const w of this.getOutNeighbors(v)) {
+				if (!index.has(w)) {
+					strongConnect(w);
+					lowlink.set(v, Math.min(lowlink.get(v), lowlink.get(w)));
+				} else if (onStack.has(w)) {
+					lowlink.set(v, Math.min(lowlink.get(v), index.get(w)));
+				}
+			}
+
+			if (lowlink.get(v) === index.get(v)) {
+				const scc = [];
+				let w;
+				do {
+					w = stack.pop();
+					onStack.delete(w);
+					scc.push(w);
+				} while (w !== v);
+				sccs.push(scc);
+			}
+		};
+
+		for (const v of this._vertices.keys()) {
+			if (!index.has(v)) {
+				strongConnect(v);
+			}
+		}
+
+		return sccs;
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Computes weakly connected components (treats arcs as undirected) using Union-Find.
+	 * @private
+	 * @returns {Map<*, number>} Map from vertex id to WCC index (0, 1, 2, ...).
+	 */
+	_computeWeaklyConnectedComponents() {
+		const parent = new Map();
+		for (const id of this._vertices.keys()) {
+			parent.set(id, id);
+		}
+
+		const find = (x) => {
+			if (parent.get(x) !== x) {
+				parent.set(x, find(parent.get(x)));
+			}
+			return parent.get(x);
+		};
+
+		const union = (x, y) => {
+			const px = find(x);
+			const py = find(y);
+			if (px !== py) {
+				parent.set(px, py);
+			}
+		};
+
+		for (const [from, targets] of this._outArcs) {
+			for (const to of targets) {
+				union(from, to);
+			}
+		}
+
+		const roots = [...new Set([...this._vertices.keys()].map(id => find(id)))];
+		const rootToId = new Map();
+		roots.forEach((r, i) => rootToId.set(r, i));
+
+		const wccByVertex = new Map();
+		for (const id of this._vertices.keys()) {
+			wccByVertex.set(id, rootToId.get(find(id)));
+		}
+		return wccByVertex;
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Adds a vertex to the graph. If it already exists, optionally updates the label.
+	 * @param {*} id - Vertex identifier.
+	 * @param {string} [label] - Display label; defaults to String(id) if omitted.
+	 * @param {GraphOptions} [opts] - Options (e.g. skipRecompute).
+	 */
+	addVertex(id, label, opts = {}) {
+		if (this._vertices.has(id)) {
+			if (label !== undefined) {
+				this._vertices.get(id).label = String(label);
+			}
+			return;
+		}
+		this._vertices.set(id, { id, label: label !== undefined ? String(label) : String(id) });
+		this._outArcs.set(id, new Set());
+		this._inArcs.set(id, new Set());
+		if (!opts.skipRecompute) this._recompute();
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Removes a vertex and all its incident arcs.
+	 * @param {*} id - Vertex identifier.
+	 * @param {GraphOptions} [opts] - Options (e.g. skipRecompute).
+	 */
+	removeVertex(id, opts = {}) {
+		if (!this._vertices.has(id)) return;
+		const outArcs = this._outArcs.get(id);
+		const inArcs = this._inArcs.get(id);
+
+		// Count arcs to remove (self-loop appears in both out and in, count once)
+		let removedArcCount = outArcs.size + inArcs.size;
+		if (outArcs.has(id)) {
+			removedArcCount -= 1;
+		}
+
+		// Remove this vertex from targets' _inArcs
+		for (const to of outArcs) {
+			if (to !== id) {
+				this._inArcs.get(to).delete(id);
+			}
+		}
+		// Remove this vertex from sources' _outArcs
+		for (const from of inArcs) {
+			if (from !== id) {
+				this._outArcs.get(from).delete(id);
+			}
+		}
+
+		this._vertices.delete(id);
+		this._outArcs.delete(id);
+		this._inArcs.delete(id);
+		this._arcCount -= removedArcCount;
+
+		if (!opts.skipRecompute) this._recompute();
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Adds an arc from one vertex to another. Creates vertices if they do not exist.
+	 * @param {*} from - Source vertex id.
+	 * @param {*} to - Target vertex id.
+	 * @param {GraphOptions} [opts] - Options (e.g. skipRecompute).
+	 */
+	addArc(from, to, opts = {}) {
+		this.addVertex(from, undefined, { skipRecompute: true });
+		this.addVertex(to, undefined, { skipRecompute: true });
+		const out = this._outArcs.get(from);
+		if (!out.has(to)) {
+			out.add(to);
+			this._inArcs.get(to).add(from);
+			this._arcCount += 1;
+			if (!opts.skipRecompute) this._recompute();
+		}
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Removes an arc between two vertices.
+	 * @param {*} from - Source vertex id.
+	 * @param {*} to - Target vertex id.
+	 * @param {GraphOptions} [opts] - Options (e.g. skipRecompute).
+	 */
+	removeArc(from, to, opts = {}) {
+		const out = this._outArcs.get(from);
+		if (out && out.has(to)) {
+			out.delete(to);
+			this._inArcs.get(to).delete(from);
+			this._arcCount -= 1;
+			if (!opts.skipRecompute) this._recompute();
+		}
+	}
+
+	setVertexLabel(id, label) {
+		if (this._vertices.has(id)) {
+			this._vertices.get(id).label = String(label);
+		}
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Checks whether a vertex exists.
+	 * @param {*} id - Vertex identifier.
+	 * @returns {boolean} True if the vertex exists.
+	 */
+	hasVertex(id) {
+		return this._vertices.has(id);
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Checks whether an arc exists from one vertex to another.
+	 * @param {*} from - Source vertex id.
+	 * @param {*} to - Target vertex id.
+	 * @returns {boolean} True if the arc exists.
+	 */
+	hasArc(from, to) {
+		const out = this._outArcs.get(from);
+		return out ? out.has(to) : false;
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns a copy of the vertex data, or null if not found.
+	 * @param {*} id - Vertex identifier.
+	 * @returns {{ id: *, label: string } | null} Vertex object or null.
+	 */
+	getVertex(id) {
+		return this._vertices.get(id) ? { ...this._vertices.get(id) } : null;
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns a copy of all vertices.
+	 * @returns {Array<{ id: *, label: string }>} Array of vertex objects.
+	 */
+	getVertices() {
+		return [...this._vertices.values()].map(v => ({ ...v }));
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns the out-neighbors of a vertex (vertices reachable by outgoing arcs).
+	 * @param {*} id - Vertex identifier.
+	 * @returns {Array<*>} Array of target vertex ids.
+	 */
+	getOutNeighbors(id) {
+		return [...(this._outArcs.get(id) || [])];
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns the in-neighbors of a vertex (vertices with arcs pointing to it).
+	 * @param {*} id - Vertex identifier.
+	 * @returns {Array<*>} Array of source vertex ids.
+	 */
+	getInNeighbors(id) {
+		return [...(this._inArcs.get(id) || [])];
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns vertices with no incoming or outgoing arcs (degree 0).
+	 * @returns {Array<*>} Array of isolate vertex ids.
+	 */
+	getIsolates() {
+		return [...this._isolates.values()];
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns strongly connected components. Each component is an array of vertex ids.
+	 * @returns {Array<Array<*>>} Array of SCCs, each an array of vertex ids.
+	 */
+	getConnectedComponents() {
+		return this._components.map(scc => [...scc]);
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns the strongly connected component containing the given vertex.
+	 * @param {*} id - Vertex identifier.
+	 * @returns {Array<*> | null} Array of vertex ids in the SCC, or null if vertex not found.
+	 */
+	getComponentForVertex(id) {
+		const idx = this._componentByVertex.get(id);
+		return idx !== undefined ? this._components[idx] : null;
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns graph statistics.
+	 * @returns {{ vertexCount: number, arcCount: number, componentCount: number, isolateCount: number }} Stats object.
+	 */
+	getStats() {
+		return { ...this._stats };
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns graph data for visualization in D3-style format.
+	 * @returns {{ nodes: Array<Object>, links: Array<{ source: *, target: * }>, stats: Object }} Visualization data.
+	 *   Each node includes: id, label, componentId, wccId, isIsolate, outDegree, inDegree.
+	 */
+	getVisualizationData() {
+		const nodes = this.getVertices().map((v) => {
+			const out = this._outArcs.get(v.id);
+			const in_ = this._inArcs.get(v.id);
+			return {
+				...v,
+				componentId: this._componentByVertex.get(v.id),
+				wccId: this._wccByVertex.get(v.id),
+				isIsolate: this._isolates.has(v.id),
+				outDegree: out ? out.size : 0,
+				inDegree: in_ ? in_.size : 0,
+			};
+		});
+		const links = [];
+		for (const [from, targets] of this._outArcs) {
+			for (const to of targets) {
+				links.push({ source: from, target: to });
+			}
+		}
+		return {
+			nodes,
+			links,
+			stats: this.getStats(),
+		};
+	}
+}
+
+module.exports = DirectedGraph;

@@ -0,0 +1,241 @@
+'use strict';
+
+const nconf = require('nconf');
+
+const db = require('../database');
+const DirectedGraph = require('./DirectedGraph');
+
+const CHUNK_SIZE = 500;
+
+/**
+ * Yields contiguous chunks of an array.
+ * @param {Array<*>} arr - Array to chunk.
+ * @param {number} size - Chunk size.
+ * @yields {Array<*>} Chunk of up to `size` elements.
+ */
+function* chunk(arr, size) {
+	for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += size) {
+		yield arr.slice(i, i + size);
+	}
+}
+
+/**
+ * Runs a batched DB operation in chunks to avoid overloading the database.
+ * @param {Array<*>} keys - Keys to process.
+ * @param {function(Array<*>): Promise<Array<*>>} fn - Async function that accepts a chunk and returns results.
+ * @returns {Promise<Array<*>>} Flattened results in the same order as keys.
+ */
+async function getChunked(keys, fn) {
+	const chunks = [...chunk(keys, CHUNK_SIZE)];
+	const results = await Promise.all(chunks.map(chunkKeys => fn(chunkKeys)));
+	return results.flat();
+}
+
+/**
+ * LinkProvider – builds and maintains a topic backlinks graph from post content.
+ * Syncs backlinks to the database and exposes graph data for visualization.
+ */
+class LinkProvider {
+	/**
+	 * Creates a LinkProvider with an empty graph and backlink regex from site URL.
+	 */
+	constructor() {
+		this._graph = new DirectedGraph();
+		const url = nconf.get('url') || '';
+		const escaped = url.replace(/\//g, '\\/');
+		this._backlinkRegex = new RegExp(`(?:${escaped}|\\b|\\s)\\/topic\\/(\\d+)(?:\\/\\w+)?`, 'g');
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Builds the graph from existing backlinks in the database.
+	 * Scans pid:*:backlinks keys, loads post TIDs and topic titles in chunks,
+	 * and populates the in-memory graph. Silently returns on scan errors.
+	 * @returns {Promise<void>}
+	 */
+	async buildFromBacklinks() {
+		this._graph = new DirectedGraph();
+
+		let keys = [];
+		try {
+			keys = await db.scan({ match: 'pid:*:backlinks' });
+		} catch (err) {
+			return;
+		}
+
+		const validKeys = keys.filter(key => /^pid:(\d+):backlinks$/.test(key));
+		const pids = validKeys.map(key => key.match(/^pid:(\d+):backlinks$/)[1]);
+		if (!pids.length) {
+			return;
+		}
+
+		const [allBacklinks, postData] = await Promise.all([
+			getChunked(validKeys, chunkKeys => db.getSortedSetsMembers(chunkKeys)),
+			getChunked(pids, chunkPids => db.getObjectsFields(chunkPids.map(pid => `post:${pid}`), ['tid'])),
+		]);
+
+		const validEntries = [];
+		const allTids = new Set();
+		for (let idx = 0; idx < pids.length; idx++) {
+			const backlinks = allBacklinks[idx] || [];
+			const tid = backlinks.length && postData[idx] ? postData[idx].tid : null;
+			const fromTid = tid ? parseInt(tid, 10) : null;
+			if (fromTid && backlinks.length) {
+				validEntries.push({ backlinks, fromTid });
+				allTids.add(fromTid);
+				for (const t of backlinks) {
+					allTids.add(parseInt(t, 10));
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		if (!validEntries.length) {
+			return;
+		}
+
+		const tids = Array.from(allTids);
+		const titleChunks = await getChunked(tids, chunkTids => db.getObjectsFields(chunkTids.map(t => `topic:${t}`), ['title']));
+		const titleMap = new Map();
+		tids.forEach((tid, idx) => {
+			const row = titleChunks[idx];
+			if (row && row.title) {
+				titleMap.set(tid, row.title);
+			}
+		});
+
+		for (const { backlinks, fromTid } of validEntries) {
+			const fromLabel = titleMap.get(fromTid);
+			for (const toTid of backlinks) {
+				const to = parseInt(toTid, 10);
+				if (fromTid !== to) {
+					this._graph.addArc(fromTid, to, { skipRecompute: true });
+					if (fromLabel) this._graph.setVertexLabel(fromTid, fromLabel);
+					const toLabel = titleMap.get(to);
+					if (toLabel) this._graph.setVertexLabel(to, toLabel);
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		this._graph._recompute();
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Syncs backlinks for a single post. Parses topic links from content,
+	 * updates the in-memory graph and database, and logs backlink events.
+	 * @param {Object} postData - Post data.
+	 * @param {number} postData.pid - Post id.
+	 * @param {number} postData.uid - User id.
+	 * @param {number} [postData.tid] - Topic id (fetched from DB if omitted).
+	 * @param {string} [postData.content] - Post content to scan for topic links.
+	 * @returns {Promise<number>} Number of new backlinks added.
+	 * @throws {Error} If postData is null/undefined.
+	 */
+	async syncBacklinks(postData) {
+		if (!postData) {
+			throw new Error('[[error:invalid-data]]');
+		}
+
+		if (require('../meta').config.topicBacklinks !== 1) {
+			return 0;
+		}
+
+		const { pid, uid, tid: postTid } = postData;
+		if (!pid) {
+			return 0;
+		}
+
+		const events = require('../topics/events');
+
+		const matches = [...(postData.content || '').matchAll(this._backlinkRegex)];
+		let add = [...new Set(matches.map(match => match[1]))];
+		const now = Date.now();
+
+		const [tidResult, current, topicsExist] = await Promise.all([
+			postTid ? Promise.resolve(postTid) : db.getObjectField(`post:${pid}`, 'tid'),
+			db.getSortedSetMembers(`pid:${pid}:backlinks`),
+			add.length ? db.exists(add.map(t => `topic:${t}`)) : Promise.resolve([]),
+		]);
+		const tid = tidResult;
+		if (!tid) {
+			return 0;
+		}
+
+		const fromTid = parseInt(tid, 10);
+		const currentParsed = (current || []).map(t => parseInt(t, 10));
+		const remove = currentParsed.filter(t => !add.includes(String(t)));
+		add = add.filter((_tid, idx) => topicsExist[idx] &&
+			!currentParsed.includes(parseInt(_tid, 10)) && fromTid !== parseInt(_tid, 10));
+
+		// Update graph: remove old arcs
+		for (const toTid of remove) {
+			this._graph.removeArc(fromTid, toTid, { skipRecompute: true });
+		}
+
+		// Update graph: add new arcs
+		for (const toTid of add) {
+			const to = parseInt(toTid, 10);
+			this._graph.addArc(fromTid, to, { skipRecompute: true });
+		}
+
+		if (remove.length || add.length) {
+			this._graph._recompute();
+		}
+
+		// Update Redis (values stored as strings)
+		await db.sortedSetRemove(`pid:${pid}:backlinks`, remove.map(String));
+		if (add.length) {
+			await db.sortedSetAdd(`pid:${pid}:backlinks`, add.map(() => now), add);
+		}
+
+		await Promise.all(add.map(async (targetTid) => {
+			await events.log(targetTid, {
+				uid,
+				type: 'backlink',
+				href: `/post/${pid}`,
+			});
+		}));
+
+		return add.length;
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns strongly connected components from the backlinks graph.
+	 * @returns {Array<Array<number>>} Array of SCCs, each an array of topic ids.
+	 */
+	getConnectedComponents() {
+		return this._graph.getConnectedComponents();
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns topic ids with no backlinks (isolates in the graph).
+	 * @returns {Array<number>} Array of isolate topic ids.
+	 */
+	getIsolates() {
+		return this._graph.getIsolates();
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns graph statistics (vertexCount, arcCount, componentCount, isolateCount).
+	 * @returns {{ vertexCount: number, arcCount: number, componentCount: number, isolateCount: number }}
+	 */
+	getStats() {
+		return this._graph.getStats();
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns graph data for visualization (nodes, links, stats) in D3-style format.
+	 * @returns {{ nodes: Array<Object>, links: Array<{ source: number, target: number }>, stats: Object }}
+	 */
+	getVisualizationData() {
+		return this._graph.getVisualizationData();
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * Returns the underlying DirectedGraph instance. Use for advanced graph operations.
+	 * @returns {DirectedGraph} The backlinks graph.
+	 */
+	getGraph() {
+		return this._graph;
+	}
+}
+
+module.exports = LinkProvider;

@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+# Architecture Decisions & Lessons Learned
+
+## Project Structure
+
+- **Config system**: YAML-based (`configdata.yml`) with types resolved via `getattr(configtypes, type_name)`.
+  - New settings: define type in `configtypes.py`, enum in `usertypes.py`, entry in `configdata.yml`.
+  - `MappingType` subclass pattern: define `MAPPING` dict mapping string keys to `(enum_value, description)` tuples.
+  - Override `to_py()` only when backward compatibility or special parsing is needed.
+- **State management**: `StateConfig` in `configfiles.py` — a `ConfigParser` wrapper persisting to `data/state`.
+  - Version tracking stored in `[general]` section (`version`, `qt_version`).
+  - Change detection happens in `__init__`, before state is overwritten with current values.
+- **App initialization**: `app.py:_open_special_pages()` handles post-upgrade UI (changelogs, warnings).
+  - Uses `configfiles.state` for version change detection and `config.val.*` for user preferences.
+- **Docs**: `doc/help/settings.asciidoc` must stay in sync with `configdata.yml` (type, default, description).
+
+## Component Boundaries
+
+| Layer | Files | Responsibility |
+|-------|-------|---------------|
+| Enum definitions | `utils/usertypes.py` | Pure enum values, no logic |
+| Config types | `config/configtypes.py` | Parsing, validation, YAML<->Python conversion |
+| Config schema | `config/configdata.yml` | Setting names, types, defaults, descriptions |
+| State persistence | `config/configfiles.py` | Read/write state file, version change detection |
+| App logic | `app.py` | Decision logic for showing changelog based on setting + version level |
+
+## Lessons Learned
+
+### Granular Changelog Control (2026-03)
+
+**Pattern**: `ChangelogAfterUpgrade` enum (`major`/`minor`/`patch`/`never`) with `MappingType` in configtypes.
+
+**Key decisions**:
+- Version change level computed as string (`'major'`/`'minor'`/`'patch'`/`None`) in `StateConfig`, not as enum — keeps config layer decoupled from enum.
+- Backward compatibility for bool values (`true`->`patch`, `false`->`never`) handled in `to_py()` override.
+- Default is `minor` — shows changelog for major + minor bumps but not patch releases.
+
+**Issues found and fixed during review**:
+1. **BUG (test)**: `test_configfiles.py` monkeypatched `__version__` with `lambda: new_version` but `__version__` is a string attribute, not a callable. Fixed to use plain string.
+2. **BUG (docs)**: `settings.asciidoc` listed type as `Bool` with default `true` — stale from before the type was changed to `ChangelogAfterUpgrade`. Fixed to `ChangelogAfterUpgrade`/`minor`.
+3. **Style**: Redundant `from qutebrowser.utils import usertypes` inside `_open_special_pages()` when `usertypes` is already imported at module level in `app.py`. Removed.
+
+**Missing test coverage (non-blocking)**:
+- No tests for `_get_version_change_level()` directly (only `qutebrowser_version_changed` bool is tested).
+- No tests for the `ChangelogAfterUpgrade` configtype, including backward-compat `to_py()` with bool values.
+- No integration test for `_open_special_pages()` changelog logic.
